name: Hamburger Hafen und Logistik Aktiengesellschaft
summary: Hamburger Hafen und Logistik Aktiengesellschaft, together with its subsidiaries, provides container handling, transport, and logistics services in Germany, Europe, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Container, Intermodal, Logistics, and Real Estate. The company handles loading, discharging, and transshipping containers to other carriers, including rail, truck, feeder, or inland waterway ships; operates container terminals; and offers container maintenance and repair services.
